archive.catalogue_description: Features -Kino Der Toten shaped starting area plus Ascension shaped outer areas. Truly shaped like the mixture of those two BO1 zombie maps features: *mp guns *kino style teleporter *easter eggs *buy-able ray gun. *pap and perks *custom power up/s *buyable ammo(i guess) *i would say *hard* even if big space *tom music box(thank u tom) *skinned zombies(finally) *more stuff Outstanding help from: *towniy *Mr.Hankey *rampage_619 *cinnober *ADDICTED *paragalor *tom_bmx *other ppl i forgot the names of Known Bugs: *some zombies will Not come out of some windows anyways this is my very first map ever. i don’t care what u say about just try it. im really sorry for the inconvenience. ALSO I MADE IT WITH BIG SPACE. Because i made it the size of the REAL kino. but turn out REALLY REALLY BAD AND TIGHT! UPDATES: added rain thanks towniy’s help added few more mp guns thanks to paragalor. story line which ill tell later. UPDATE: mp guns now upgradable, also this project didnt turn out great but lets wait till my second map. NOTE!: it wasnt finished because of an error but hope u enjoy! another note: DONT USE TEH ZAPPERS IT DOES NOT WORK!!
